VENUE RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Venue Rental Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of February 14, 2026 between Ashgrove Conservatory, a Michigan nonprofit corporation ("Venue"), and Delacroix & Finch LLP, a Michigan limited liability partnership ("Renter").

1. THE EVENT AND THE SPACE

1.1 Space. Venue grants Renter a licence to use the Grand Atrium and the adjoining East Terrace at 1200 Conservatory Drive, Ann Arbor, Michigan (the "Space") for Renter's firm anniversary reception (the "Event").

1.2 Date and Hours. The Event is on Saturday, June 20, 2026. Renter has access from 2:00 p.m. for setup, the Event runs from 6:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m., and Renter shall complete load-out and vacate the Space by 1:00 a.m. on June 21, 2026.

1.3 Capacity. Attendance may not exceed 220 persons, which is the occupancy the fire marshal has approved for the Space in a seated configuration.

1.4 Licence, Not a Lease. This Agreement grants a revocable licence to use the Space for the stated hours, and creates no leasehold estate, tenancy, or other interest in real property.

2. FEES AND PAYMENT

2.1 Rental Fee. The rental fee is $14,500.

2.2 Deposit. Renter shall pay a non-refundable booking deposit of $4,350 on execution of this Agreement, applied against the rental fee.

2.3 Balance. Renter shall pay the balance of $10,150 no later than thirty (30) days before the Event.

2.4 Security Deposit. Renter shall provide a refundable damage deposit of $2,500 no later than fourteen (14) days before the Event. Venue shall return it, less the documented cost of any damage beyond ordinary wear and any overtime charges, within thirty (30) days after the Event, with an itemized statement of any deduction.

2.5 Overtime. If Renter has not vacated by the time stated in Section 1.2, Venue may charge $750 per hour or part of an hour.

3. VENDORS AND SERVICES

3.1 Caterer. Renter shall use a caterer from Venue's approved list, or a caterer Venue approves in writing, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. The caterer shall carry the insurance described in Section 5 and shall name Venue as an additional insured.

3.2 Alcohol. Alcohol may be served only by a licensed bartender supplied by the caterer, only during the Event hours, and only to guests aged twenty-one (21) or older. Service shall stop thirty (30) minutes before the end of the Event. Renter shall not sell alcohol or accept any payment for it.

3.3 Music and Noise. Amplified music is permitted indoors until 11:00 p.m. and on the East Terrace until 9:30 p.m., subject to the Ann Arbor noise ordinance.

3.4 Décor. Renter shall not affix anything to walls, columns, or plantings, shall use no open flame other than enclosed votive candles, and shall not use confetti, glitter, or rice.

4. CONDUCT AND CONDITION

4.1 Compliance. Renter shall comply, and shall cause its guests and vendors to comply, with Venue's posted rules, all applicable law, and the directions of Venue's staff.

4.2 Condition. Renter shall return the Space in the condition received, ordinary wear excepted, and is responsible for the cost of repairing damage caused by Renter, its guests, or its vendors.

4.3 Right to Enter. Venue's staff may enter the Space at any time, and Venue may stop the Event if there is a threat to safety, a breach of Section 3.2, or a violation of the occupancy limit, in which case no refund is due.

5. INSURANCE AND INDEMNITY

5.1 Renter's Insurance. Renter shall obtain and deliver, at least fourteen (14) days before the Event, a certificate of commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate, with host liquor liability, naming Venue as an additional insured for the Event.

5.2 Renter Indemnity. Renter shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Venue and its trustees, officers, employees, and volunteers against any claim arising out of the Event, out of the acts or omissions of Renter, its guests, or its vendors, or out of Renter's breach of this Agreement, except to the extent caused by Venue's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

5.3 Venue Indemnity. Venue shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Renter against any claim arising out of the structural condition of the Space or Venue's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

5.4 Personal Property. Venue is not responsible for property Renter or its guests leave at the Space, and Renter shall remove all such property at load-out.

6. CANCELLATION AND FORCE MAJEURE

6.1 Cancellation by Renter. If Renter cancels more than one hundred twenty (120) days before the Event, Renter forfeits the booking deposit only. Between one hundred twenty (120) and sixty (60) days, Renter owes fifty percent (50%) of the rental fee. Within sixty (60) days, Renter owes the full rental fee.

6.2 Cancellation by Venue. If Venue cancels for any reason other than Renter's breach, Venue shall refund all amounts paid and shall reimburse Renter's documented non-recoverable vendor deposits up to $5,000.

6.3 Force Majeure. If the Event cannot be held because of a cause beyond either party's reasonable control, including a government order, a public-health closure, a fire, or a severe weather event, Venue shall, at Renter's election, refund all amounts paid other than documented out-of-pocket costs Venue has already incurred, or reschedule the Event on a mutually acceptable date within twelve (12) months at no additional rental fee.

7. GENERAL

7.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Michigan. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state courts located in Washtenaw County, Michigan.

7.2 Assignment. Renter may not assign this Agreement or permit any other person to use the Space.

7.3 Photography. Venue may photograph the Space before and after the Event for its records, and may not photograph guests or use any image of the Event for promotion without Renter's written consent.

7.4 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by electronic mail with confirmation of receipt to the addresses stated beneath the signatures.

7.5 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

AGREED:

ASHGROVE CONSERVATORY
